title: A positive colour-singlet gap from exact Fold closure
description:
Read the complete paper (PDF)

The generated colour-three sector has an exact positive normalized singlet gap of one-third at every positive finite depth.

Maria Smith derives the complete period-two one-third/two-thirds Fold partition, least nonempty singlet support, exact confinement-work successor and finite witness beyond every positive rational work bound. The locally massless carrier retains One-cell causal propagation while the physical singlet remains positively separated.

The paper presents every intermediate argument, the complete 2,916-form carrier and 1,024-form singlet grammars, all-depth native Lean proofs, and the complete sealed 256-form spectrum comparison. All three registered pure-gauge lattice intervals are positive and disjoint: 1627–1679, 2344–2408 and 2521–2601 MeV. The formal result supplies the normalized one-third gap; the external spectrum retains its dimensional masses and original source scope.

Includes full mathematics, exact rational reproduction, source correspondence, original controls, pinned V3/V4 evidence and 352 audited declarations with empty axiom dependencies. Scientific author: Maria Smith, Ernos Labs.
